The displayed zero cut is therefore a model restriction within the adjacent hold/hike interpolation, not a directly observed exchange probability.

The market strip is source-reproducible at review time and all ten exact 15:59 epochs match the hashed full-precision rows, but Yahoo minute history remains a revisable vendor representation rather than certified exchange settlement data. BoC single-meeting pricing is deliberately unavailable. The CRA September 2026 contract quote of 97.600 bid and 97.605 ask, with 31,621 volume, implies a 2.3975% rate from the midpoint under compounded daily CORRA over the reference quarter; because that horizon spans both October 28 and December 9 decisions, no October cut/hold/hike allocation or meeting-specific implied rate can be inferred.
